list.name: trial_accounts
list.label: Trial account ids
list.description: The runner's BOT_HUMANIZE_ACCOUNTS: a comma list of game_accounts.id values. Empty puts every account in 'other'.

options.content:
### Filling the variable

Put the runner's `BOT_HUMANIZE_ACCOUNTS` value in **Trial account ids** at the top: the comma list of `game_accounts.id` values from the runner's environment (`infra/.env`). Spaces are ignored. Every account that isn't listed is in **other**.

With the box empty, every account is in **other** and the trial lines are empty. That is also the state of a fleet-wide rollout (`BOT_HUMANIZE_ACCOUNTS` empty); compare the weeks before and after it instead.

The stat on the right counts the listed ids that match an account. A listed id that matches nothing is a typo or a removed account. To find an account's id, open Explore, pick GGE Postgres and run `select id, name from game_accounts where lower(name) = lower('the castle name')`.

Each point is one UTC day. An account counts as running on a day when one of its runs overlapped that day. Crashes are runs that ended in `crash`, `error` or `stale`, as in the *Bots are crashing* alert.

### Why not Prometheus

No metric carries an account id. A label value per account multiplies every series by the fleet size, and anyone who can read Prometheus could read the ids. Postgres already records every run in `bot_runs`, so the cohorts are compared here.

Bans are rare, so a few trial accounts over a few days can't show a difference in ban rate. Use the trial to catch breakage (auth failures, crashes) and weeks of fleet-wide data to judge bans.

panels.title: Trial ids listed, matched to an account, and run in the range

targets.rawSql: with trial as (select string_to_array(replace('$trial_accounts', ' ', ''), ',') as ids) select cardinality(array_remove(trial.ids, '')) as listed, (select count(*) from game_accounts a where a.id::text = any (trial.ids)) as "matched", (select count(distinct r.account_id) from bot_runs r where r.account_id::text = any (trial.ids) and r.started_at < $__timeTo()::timestamptz and coalesce(r.ended_at, now()) > $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) as "ran in range" from trial

panels.title: Bans per 100 running accounts, per day

targets.rawSql: with trial as (select string_to_array(replace('$trial_accounts', ' ', ''), ',') as ids), days as (select generate_series(date_bin('1 day', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, timestamptz 'epoch'), $__timeTo()::timestamptz, interval '1 day') as day), runs as ( select r.account_id, r.started_at, r.ended_at, coalesce(r.ended_at, now()) as until, r.end_reason, case when r.account_id::text = any (trial.ids) then 'trial' else 'other' end as cohort from bot_runs r, trial where r.started_at < $__timeTo()::timestamptz and coalesce(r.ended_at, now()) > $__timeFrom()::timestamptz), daily as ( select d.day, c.cohort, count(distinct ru.account_id) as accounts, count(*) filter (where ru.end_reason = 'banned' and ru.ended_at >= d.day and ru.ended_at < d.day + interval '1 day') as bans, count(*) filter (where ru.end_reason = 'auth_failed' and ru.ended_at >= d.day and ru.ended_at < d.day + interval '1 day') as auth_failures, count(*) filter (where ru.end_reason in ('crash', 'error', 'stale') and ru.ended_at >= d.day and ru.ended_at < d.day + interval '1 day') as crashes, count(*) filter (where ru.started_at >= d.day and ru.started_at < d.day + interval '1 day') as starts from days d cross join (values ('trial'), ('other')) c (cohort) left join runs ru on ru.cohort = c.cohort and ru.started_at < d.day + interval '1 day' and ru.until > d.day group by 1, 2) select day as time, cohort as metric, round(100.0 * bans / nullif(accounts, 0), 2) as value from daily order by 1, 2

panels.title: Runs started per running account, per day
panels.description: More runs per account means more restarts: crashes, retries or schedule windows.

targets.rawSql: with trial as (select string_to_array(replace('$trial_accounts', ' ', ''), ',') as ids), days as (select generate_series(date_bin('1 day', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, timestamptz 'epoch'), $__timeTo()::timestamptz, interval '1 day') as day), runs as ( select r.account_id, r.started_at, r.ended_at, coalesce(r.ended_at, now()) as until, r.end_reason, case when r.account_id::text = any (trial.ids) then 'trial' else 'other' end as cohort from bot_runs r, trial where r.started_at < $__timeTo()::timestamptz and coalesce(r.ended_at, now()) > $__timeFrom()::timestamptz), daily as ( select d.day, c.cohort, count(distinct ru.account_id) as accounts, count(*) filter (where ru.end_reason = 'banned' and ru.ended_at >= d.day and ru.ended_at < d.day + interval '1 day') as bans, count(*) filter (where ru.end_reason = 'auth_failed' and ru.ended_at >= d.day and ru.ended_at < d.day + interval '1 day') as auth_failures, count(*) filter (where ru.end_reason in ('crash', 'error', 'stale') and ru.ended_at >= d.day and ru.ended_at < d.day + interval '1 day') as crashes, count(*) filter (where ru.started_at >= d.day and ru.started_at < d.day + interval '1 day') as starts from days d cross join (values ('trial'), ('other')) c (cohort) left join runs ru on ru.cohort = c.cohort and ru.started_at < d.day + interval '1 day' and ru.until > d.day group by 1, 2) select day as time, cohort as metric, round(starts::numeric / nullif(accounts, 0), 2) as value from daily order by 1, 2
